about: Bicycles: coasting and pedalling, the bell, brakes, gear clicks and a fall.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

roll.want: coasting: the freewheel ticking and tyres humming

prompts.text: A bicycle coasts along a paved road: the freewheel hub ticks fast and the thin tyres hum, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A bicycle is pedalled steadily along a road: the chain whirs over the sprockets, the tyres hum and the pedals creak softly in rhythm, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A bicycle bell rings, a bright double ring, five separate rings with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A bicycle's rim brakes squeal as it stops, four separate stops with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A bicycle's rim brakes squeal sharply for one second as it stops, then silence. Loud and close. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A bicycle's derailleur shifts gear: a quick metallic click and the chain clattering onto the next sprocket, six separate shifts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A bicycle falls over onto a road: a clattering metal crash with the bell pinging and the wheel spinning, three separate falls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
